content.text: Enter Antipholus and Dromio of Syracuse and a Merchant.

lines.text: Therefore give out you are of Epidamnum,
lines.plainText: Therefore give out you are of Epidamnum

lines.text: Lest that your goods too soon be confiscate.
lines.plainText: Lest that your goods too soon be confiscate

lines.text: This very day a Syracusian merchant
lines.plainText: This very day a Syracusian merchant

lines.text: Is apprehended for arrival here,
lines.plainText: Is apprehended for arrival here

lines.text: And, not being able to buy out his life,
lines.plainText: And not being able to buy out his life

lines.text: According to the statute of the town
lines.plainText: According to the statute of the town

lines.text: Dies ere the weary sun set in the west.
lines.plainText: Dies ere the weary sun set in the west

lines.text: There is your money that I had to keep.
lines.plainText: There is your money that I had to keep

lines.text: Go bear it to the Centaur, where we host,
lines.plainText: Go bear it to the Centaur where we host

lines.text: And stay there, Dromio, till I come to thee.
lines.plainText: And stay there Dromio till I come to thee

lines.text: Within this hour it will be dinnertime;
lines.plainText: Within this hour it will be dinnertime

lines.text: Till that, I'll view the manners of the town,
lines.plainText: Till that I'll view the manners of the town

lines.text: Peruse the traders, gaze upon the buildings,
lines.plainText: Peruse the traders gaze upon the buildings

lines.text: And then return and sleep within mine inn,
lines.plainText: And then return and sleep within mine inn

lines.text: For with long travel I am stiff and weary.
lines.plainText: For with long travel I am stiff and weary

lines.text: Get thee away.
lines.plainText: Get thee away

lines.text: Many a man would take you at your word,
lines.plainText: Many a man would take you at your word

lines.text: And go indeed, having so good a mean.
lines.plainText: And go indeed having so good a mean

lines.text: A trusty villain, sir, that very oft,
lines.plainText: A trusty villain sir that very oft

lines.text: When I am dull with care and melancholy,
lines.plainText: When I am dull with care and melancholy

lines.text: Lightens my humour with his merry jests.
lines.plainText: Lightens my humour with his merry jests

lines.text: What, will you walk with me about the town,
lines.plainText: What will you walk with me about the town

lines.text: And then go to my inn and dine with me?
lines.plainText: And then go to my inn and dine with me

lines.text: I am invited, sir, to certain merchants,
lines.plainText: I am invited sir to certain merchants

lines.text: Of whom I hope to make much benefit.
lines.plainText: Of whom I hope to make much benefit

lines.text: I crave your pardon. Soon, at five o'clock,
lines.plainText: I crave your pardon Soon at five o'clock

lines.text: Please you, I'll meet with you upon the mart,
lines.plainText: Please you I'll meet with you upon the mart

lines.text: And afterward consort you till bedtime.
lines.plainText: And afterward consort you till bedtime

lines.text: My present business calls me from you now.
lines.plainText: My present business calls me from you now

lines.text: Farewell till then: I will go lose myself,
lines.plainText: Farewell till then I will go lose myself

lines.text: And wander up and down to view the city.
lines.plainText: And wander up and down to view the city

lines.text: Sir, I commend you to your own content.
lines.plainText: Sir I commend you to your own content

lines.text: He that commends me to mine own content
lines.plainText: He that commends me to mine own content

lines.text: Commends me to the thing I cannot get.
lines.plainText: Commends me to the thing I cannot get

lines.text: I to the world am like a drop of water
lines.plainText: I to the world am like a drop of water

lines.text: That in the ocean seeks another drop,
lines.plainText: That in the ocean seeks another drop

lines.text: Who, failing there to find his fellow forth,
lines.plainText: Who failing there to find his fellow forth

lines.text: Unseen, inquisitive, confounds himself.
lines.plainText: Unseen inquisitive confounds himself

lines.text: So I, to find a mother and a brother,
lines.plainText: So I to find a mother and a brother

lines.text: In quest of them, unhappy, lose myself.
lines.plainText: In quest of them unhappy lose myself

lines.text: Return'd so soon? rather approach'd too late.
lines.plainText: Return'd so soon rather approach'd too late

lines.text: The capon burns, the pig falls from the spit;
lines.plainText: The capon burns the pig falls from the spit

lines.text: The clock hath strucken twelve upon the bell;
lines.plainText: The clock hath strucken twelve upon the bell

lines.text: My mistress made it one upon my cheek.
lines.plainText: My mistress made it one upon my cheek

lines.text: She is so hot because the meat is cold;
lines.plainText: She is so hot because the meat is cold

lines.text: The meat is cold because you come not home;
lines.plainText: The meat is cold because you come not home

lines.text: You come not home because you have no stomach;
lines.plainText: You come not home because you have no stomach

lines.text: You have no stomach, having broke your fast;
lines.plainText: You have no stomach having broke your fast

lines.text: But we that know what 'tis to fast and pray,
lines.plainText: But we that know what 'tis to fast and pray

lines.text: Are penitent for your default today.
lines.plainText: Are penitent for your default today

lines.text: Stop in your wind, sir, tell me this, I pray:
lines.plainText: Stop in your wind sir tell me this I pray

lines.text: Where have you left the money that I gave you?
lines.plainText: Where have you left the money that I gave you

lines.text: O, sixpence that I had o' Wednesday last
lines.plainText: O sixpence that I had o' Wednesday last

lines.text: To pay the saddler for my mistress' crupper:
lines.plainText: To pay the saddler for my mistress' crupper

lines.text: The saddler had it, sir, I kept it not.
lines.plainText: The saddler had it sir I kept it not

lines.text: I am not in a sportive humour now.
lines.plainText: I am not in a sportive humour now

lines.text: Tell me, and dally not, where is the money?
lines.plainText: Tell me and dally not where is the money

lines.text: We being strangers here, how dar'st thou trust
lines.plainText: We being strangers here how dar'st thou trust

lines.text: So great a charge from thine own custody?
lines.plainText: So great a charge from thine own custody

lines.text: I pray you jest, sir, as you sit at dinner:
lines.plainText: I pray you jest sir as you sit at dinner

lines.text: I from my mistress come to you in post;
lines.plainText: I from my mistress come to you in post

lines.text: If I return, I shall be post indeed,
lines.plainText: If I return I shall be post indeed

lines.text: For she will score your fault upon my pate.
lines.plainText: For she will score your fault upon my pate

lines.text: Methinks your maw, like mine, should be your clock,
lines.plainText: Methinks your maw like mine should be your clock

lines.text: And strike you home without a messenger.
lines.plainText: And strike you home without a messenger

lines.text: Come, Dromio, come, these jests are out of season,
lines.plainText: Come Dromio come these jests are out of season

lines.text: Reserve them till a merrier hour than this.
lines.plainText: Reserve them till a merrier hour than this

lines.text: Where is the gold I gave in charge to thee?
lines.plainText: Where is the gold I gave in charge to thee

lines.text: To me, sir? why, you gave no gold to me!
lines.plainText: To me sir why you gave no gold to me

lines.text: Come on, sir knave, have done your foolishness,
lines.plainText: Come on sir knave have done your foolishness

lines.text: And tell me how thou hast dispos'd thy charge.
lines.plainText: And tell me how thou hast dispos'd thy charge

lines.text: My charge was but to fetch you from the mart
lines.plainText: My charge was but to fetch you from the mart

lines.text: Home to your house, the Phoenix, sir, to dinner.
lines.plainText: Home to your house the Phoenix sir to dinner

lines.text: My mistress and her sister stay for you.
lines.plainText: My mistress and her sister stay for you

lines.text: Now, as I am a Christian, answer me
lines.plainText: Now as I am a Christian answer me

lines.text: In what safe place you have bestow'd my money,
lines.plainText: In what safe place you have bestow'd my money

lines.text: Or I shall break that merry sconce of yours
lines.plainText: Or I shall break that merry sconce of yours

lines.text: That stands on tricks when I am undispos'd;
lines.plainText: That stands on tricks when I am undispos'd

lines.text: Where is the thousand marks thou hadst of me?
lines.plainText: Where is the thousand marks thou hadst of me

lines.text: I have some marks of yours upon my pate,
lines.plainText: I have some marks of yours upon my pate

lines.text: Some of my mistress' marks upon my shoulders,
lines.plainText: Some of my mistress' marks upon my shoulders

lines.text: But not a thousand marks between you both.
lines.plainText: But not a thousand marks between you both

lines.text: If I should pay your worship those again,
lines.plainText: If I should pay your worship those again

lines.text: Perchance you will not bear them patiently.
lines.plainText: Perchance you will not bear them patiently

lines.text: Thy mistress' marks? what mistress, slave, hast thou?
lines.plainText: Thy mistress' marks what mistress slave hast thou

lines.text: Your worship's wife, my mistress at the Phoenix;
lines.plainText: Your worship's wife my mistress at the Phoenix

lines.text: She that doth fast till you come home to dinner,
lines.plainText: She that doth fast till you come home to dinner

lines.text: And prays that you will hie you home to dinner.
lines.plainText: And prays that you will hie you home to dinner

lines.text: What, wilt thou flout me thus unto my face,
lines.plainText: What wilt thou flout me thus unto my face

lines.text: Being forbid? There, take you that, sir knave.
lines.plainText: Being forbid There take you that sir knave

lines.text: What mean you, sir? for God's sake hold your hands.
lines.plainText: What mean you sir for God's sake hold your hands

lines.text: Nay, an you will not, sir, I'll take my heels.
lines.plainText: Nay an you will not sir I'll take my heels

lines.text: Upon my life, by some device or other
lines.plainText: Upon my life by some device or other

lines.text: The villain is o'er-raught of all my money.
lines.plainText: The villain is o'erraught of all my money

lines.text: They say this town is full of cozenage,
lines.plainText: They say this town is full of cozenage

lines.text: As nimble jugglers that deceive the eye,
lines.plainText: As nimble jugglers that deceive the eye

lines.text: Dark-working sorcerers that change the mind,
lines.plainText: Darkworking sorcerers that change the mind

lines.text: Soul-killing witches that deform the body,
lines.plainText: Soulkilling witches that deform the body

lines.text: Disguised cheaters, prating mountebanks,
lines.plainText: Disguised cheaters prating mountebanks

lines.text: And many such-like liberties of sin:
lines.plainText: And many suchlike liberties of sin

lines.text: If it prove so, I will be gone the sooner.
lines.plainText: If it prove so I will be gone the sooner

lines.text: I'll to the Centaur to go seek this slave.
lines.plainText: I'll to the Centaur to go seek this slave

lines.text: I greatly fear my money is not safe.
lines.plainText: I greatly fear my money is not safe
